---
title: "Popularity of Baby Names Over Time"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  message: false
  warning: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Calculate each name's share of total births per year before filtering by name
read_csv("ssa-baby-names.csv") |>
  filter(year >= 2000, year <= 2025) |>
  mutate(pct = count / sum(count), .by = year) |>
  filter(
    name %in% c("Isabella", "Ava", "Maia", "Savannah"),
    sex == "F"
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = pct, color = name)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(2000, 2025)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  labs(
    title = "Babies Named Ava, Isabella, Maia, and Savannah (2000–2025)",
    subtitle = "Percentage of all U.S. births in the SSA dataset each year",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Percentage of Babies",
    color = "Name",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Social Security Administration"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
